5 /-! A cyclic list of actual corner triangles covering a whole surface
6 neighborhood of a vertex. These triangles may be proper parts of faces. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
9 
10 open Set
11 
12 structure VertexFaceFan (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (pole : P.Vertex) (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] where
13   order : Fin n ≃ P.edgeGraph.neighborSet pole
14   face : Fin n → P.Face
15   consecutive : ∀ i, (P.neighborLink pole).Adj (order i) (order (i + 1))
16   pole_mem : ∀ i, (pole : Space) ∈ (face i).val
17   left_mem : ∀ i, ((order i).val : Space) ∈ (face i).val
18   right_mem : ∀ i, ((order (i + 1)).val : Space) ∈ (face i).val
19 
20 theorem exists_vertex_face_fan (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
21     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
22       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
23     (pole : P.Vertex) {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (degree : P.edgeGraph.degree pole = n) :
24     Nonempty (P.VertexFaceFan pole n) := by
25   obtain ⟨order, consecutive⟩ := P.neighborLink_cyclic_order size small_faces pole degree
26   choose faces on_face using fun i => (consecutive i).2
27   exact ⟨⟨order, faces, consecutive, fun i => (on_face i).1,
28     fun i => (on_face i).2.1, fun i => (on_face i).2.2⟩⟩
29 
30 namespace VertexFaceFan
31 
32 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {pole : P.Vertex} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
33   (fan : P.VertexFaceFan pole n)
34 
35 def neighbor (i : Fin n) : P.Vertex := (fan.order i).val
36 
37 theorem adjacent (i : Fin n) : P.edgeGraph.Adj pole (fan.neighbor i) := (fan.order i).property
38 
39 theorem neighbors_distinct : Function.Injective fan.neighbor :=
40   fun _ _ same => fan.order.injective (Subtype.ext same)
41 
42 theorem successive_distinct (i : Fin n) : fan.neighbor i ≠ fan.neighbor (i + 1) :=
43   fun same => (fan.consecutive i).1 (Subtype.ext same)
44 
45 theorem neighbor_ne_pole (i : Fin n) : (fan.neighbor i : Space) ≠ pole :=
46   fun same => (fan.adjacent i).ne (Subtype.ext same.symm)
47 
48 def triangle (i : Fin n) : Set Space :=
49   convexHull ℝ ({(pole : Space), (fan.neighbor i : Space), (fan.neighbor (i + 1) : Space)} : Set Space)
50 
51 theorem triangle_subset_face (i : Fin n) : fan.triangle i ⊆ (fan.face i).val := by
52   apply convexHull_min _ (fan.face i).convex
53   rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl)
54   exacts [fan.pole_mem i, fan.left_mem i, fan.right_mem i]
55 
56 theorem triangle_noncollinear (i : Fin n) :
57     ¬ Collinear ℝ ({(fan.neighbor i : Space), (pole : Space),
58       (fan.neighbor (i + 1) : Space)} : Set Space) :=
59   P.no_three_collinear_vertices (fan.neighbor i).property pole.property
60     (fan.neighbor (i + 1)).property (fan.neighbor_ne_pole i)
61     (fun same => fan.successive_distinct i (Subtype.ext same))
62     (fan.neighbor_ne_pole (i + 1)).symm
63 
64 variable (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
65   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
66 
67 include small_faces in
68 /-- The listed faces exhaust every incident original face. -/
69 theorem covers (F : P.Face) : (pole : Space) ∈ F.val ↔ F ∈ range fan.face := by
70   have three : 3 ≤ n := by
71     have count := Nat.card_congr fan.order
72     have lower := P.edgeGraph_min_degree pole
73     rw [Nat.card_fin, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree] at count
74     omega
75   have two (v : P.edgeGraph.neighborSet pole) : ((P.neighborLink pole).neighborSet v).ncard = 2 := by
76     obtain ⟨c, d, different, neighbors⟩ := P.neighborLink_two_neighbors small_faces pole v
77     rw [neighbors, Set.ncard_pair different]
78   constructor
79   · intro poleF
80     obtain ⟨b, pb, bF⟩ := F.exists_corner_edge (small_faces F) pole poleF
81     obtain ⟨c, cb, pc, cF, _⟩ := F.exists_other_corner_neighbor (small_faces F) pole b pb poleF bF
82     let B : P.edgeGraph.neighborSet pole := ⟨b, pb⟩
83     let C : P.edgeGraph.neighborSet pole := ⟨c, pc⟩
84     let i := fan.order.symm B
85     have at_i : fan.order i = B := fan.order.apply_symm_apply B
86     have adjacent : (P.neighborLink pole).Adj B C :=
87       ⟨fun same => cb (congrArg Subtype.val same).symm, F, poleF, bF, cF⟩
88     have member : C ∈ (P.neighborLink pole).neighborSet (fan.order i) := by
89       rw [at_i]; exact adjacent
90     rw [spanning_cycle_neighbors (P.neighborLink pole) three two fan.order fan.consecutive i] at member
91     have at_b : fan.neighbor i = b := congrArg Subtype.val at_i
92     rcases member with previous | next
93     · have at_c : fan.neighbor (i - 1) = c := (congrArg Subtype.val previous).symm
94       refine ⟨i - 1, ?_⟩
95       apply (fan.face (i - 1)).eq_of_three_vertices F pole c b pc.ne pb.ne cb
96         (fan.pole_mem _) (by simpa only [← at_c] using fan.left_mem (i - 1))
97         (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel, ← at_b] using fan.right_mem (i - 1)) poleF cF bF
98     · have at_c : fan.neighbor (i + 1) = c := (congrArg Subtype.val next).symm
99       refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
100       exact (fan.face i).eq_of_three_vertices F pole b c pb.ne pc.ne cb.symm
101         (fan.pole_mem _) (at_b ▸ fan.left_mem i) (at_c ▸ fan.right_mem i) poleF bF cF
102   · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
103     exact fan.pole_mem i
104 
105 include small_faces in
106 /-- The actual corner triangles cover the entire surface near the pole. -/
107 theorem surface_neighborhood :
108     ∃ U : Set Space, IsOpen U ∧ (pole : Space) ∈ U ∧
109       U ∩ frontier P.body ⊆ ⋃ i : Fin n, fan.triangle i := by
110   have local_cover (i : Fin n) := (fan.face i).corner_triangle_neighborhood (small_faces _)
111     pole (fan.neighbor i) (fan.neighbor (i + 1)) (fan.adjacent i) (fan.adjacent (i + 1))
112     (fan.successive_distinct i) (fan.pole_mem i) (fan.left_mem i) (fan.right_mem i)
113   choose U openU poleU inside using local_cover
114   obtain ⟨V, openV, poleV, incident⟩ := P.incident_facets_neighborhood pole
115   refine ⟨V ∩ ⋂ i, U i, openV.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite openU),
116     ⟨poleV, mem_iInter.mpr poleU⟩, ?_⟩
117   rintro x ⟨⟨near, allU⟩, surface⟩
118   obtain ⟨F, member⟩ := P.boundary_point_in_face surface
119   obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (fan.covers small_faces F).mp (incident x near F member)
120   exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, inside i ⟨mem_iInter.mp allU i, member⟩⟩
121 
122 end VertexFaceFan
